events.title: A patch (ID 4718) for demo has just arrived
events.summary: Hello,This is a small patch with one important change that we heard you asking for: it was way too easy to accidentally click on an already fully painted part and reset its color. To prevent that from happening again, the color won't reset when clicking on such a part anymore; you can just go back and continue working on the remaining parts :)Patch notes:Paint color resets only when a new color is chosen, not when color selection panel appearsFixed broken tool hiding animation when pressing Back

events.title: ✨ The Reshine Demo Is Out Now!
events.summary: The wait is over! The Reshine demo is now available on Steam, and we can't wait for you to try it!Take forgotten antiques apart, clean away years of dirt and rust, restore every little detail, and carefully put everything back together. No deadlines. No shop management. No pressure. Just cozy, satisfying restoration at your own pace.🎮 Give the demo a try and let us know what you think!Thank you for being part of this journey. ❤️

events.title: Announcing Reshine!
events.summary: Hello there!We’re delighted to present our new upcoming project!Reshine is a cozy, minimalistic restoration game where you take apart, restore, and reassemble items. Remove dirt and rust, choose your colors, and give old objects a new life.Relax in your own attic and enjoy bringing items back to their former glory!In this game, there are no time limits or wrong choices - you can simply sit back, listen to the sound of rain, and enjoy the atmosphere.
